headline: Ashapura Intimates Fashion Limited: Suspension of Trading
sum: Suspension of Trading - Members of the Exchange are hereby informed that the trading in equity shares of Ashapura Intimates Fashion Limited shall remain to be suspended on account of Reduction of Share Capital pursuant to NCLT order.
